show.description: "Heart Beats Only For You" is a heartbreaking romantic drama of eternal love, sacrifice, and fate. Meera’s world shatters when she discovers Arjun’s betrayal, unaware he is hiding a fatal illness and pushing her away to protect her dreams. As secrets, scandals, and destiny collide, their love is tested to its final breath—where passion meets tragedy in the most unforgettable way. Watch "Heart Beats Only For You" only on KUKU TV!
